WITH __pa AS (
  SELECT
    new_existing,
    sponsorship_name,
    stdr_mt,
    churn_prob,
    member_weight
  FROM GN_DW.SERVING.ML_MEMBER_PRED_AXIS_V
), base AS (
  SELECT
    pa.new_existing,
    pa.sponsorship_name,
    SUM(pa.churn_prob * pa.member_weight) AS expected_churn_members
  FROM __pa AS pa
  WHERE
    pa.stdr_mt = '202609'
    AND NOT pa.new_existing IS NULL
    AND NOT pa.sponsorship_name IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    pa.new_existing,
    pa.sponsorship_name
)
SELECT
  new_existing AS "신규기존",
  sponsorship_name AS "후원사업",
  expected_churn_members AS "기대 중단 회원수(명)"
FROM base
ORDER BY
  expected_churn_members DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
